title: Jonah Part 4
textBlocks:
JOHAN IS ANGRY
BECAUSE GOD FORGIVES NIVEVEH

Then Jonah gets angry about a 
WORM eating a vine that was giving him shade!

Jonah had to learn that God is in control.
God can make a vine grow.
He can send a worm to kill the vine.
And He can forgive who He wants

Dear Lord 
Thank you for forgiving us of all the wrong things that we do.
Please soften our hearts so that we forgive other people.
Amen

Matthew 12:40
For as Jonah was in the belly of the great fish for three days and three nights….
